description: This file provides utility functions for cryptographic operations related to organization ID generation and decryption, using the CryptoJS library. It handles encryption of emails to generate organization IDs and includes validation for tenant salt.

methods.name: hexToWordArray
methods.description: Converts a hexadecimal string into a CryptoJS WordArray for cryptographic operations.

methods.name: generateOrganizationId
methods.description: Generates an organization ID by encrypting a normalized email with a tenant-specific salt using AES-128-ECB and encoding the result.

methods.name: decryptOrganizationId
methods.description: Decrypts an encrypted organization ID back to the original email for debugging purposes.

methods.name: isTenantSaltValid
methods.description: Checks if the tenant salt is valid (non-empty).
